top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the optical lattice clock with the cleanest credit on the slate (Katori for magic-wavelength trapping, Ye for its realisation at 10^-18), reproduced and compared across JILA, RIKEN, PTB, NIST and SYRTE, with the many-body physics inside the clock understood. P004 keeps the same part but adds a single-laureate IceCube part I cannot judge as a kinship or credit match, so it ranks second. P002 is a strong, falsifiable discovery but is young, has an open pairing mechanism and a contested three-name credit. P003 is clean but narrower and still developing in application. Any award ranks above no award.
recusal_note: Director of WACQT and a Chalmers superconducting-circuits theorist, so circuit QED (B004) would be a possible recusal, but it is not on this slate; no specific conflict with B029, B031 or B001 beyond ordinary acquaintance with the quantum-technology community.
